randomizeIntroMon.tip: Randomize the Pokémon shown in the game intro

baseStatsFollowEvolutions.tip: Make evolution stats follow base stats changes

baseStatsFollowMegaEvolutions.tip: Make mega evolution stats follow base stats changes

assignEvoStatsRandomly.tip: Randomly assign stats for evolved forms

updateBaseStatsToGeneration.tip: Select the target generation for base stats updates

bstFollowEvolutions.tip: Make evolution BST changes follow evolution stats

bstShuffleSwapLegendaries.label: BST Shuffle Swap Legendaries
bstShuffleSwapLegendaries.tip: Treat legendaries specially during BST shuffle

typesFollowMegaEvolutions.label: Types Follow Mega Evolutions
typesFollowMegaEvolutions.tip: Make mega evolution types follow base types

allowWonderGuard.label: Allow Wonder Guard
allowWonderGuard.tip: Allow Wonder Guard ability in randomization

banBadAbilities.label: Ban Bad Abilities
banBadAbilities.tip: Prevent weak abilities from being assigned

banTrappingAbilities.label: Ban Trapping Abilities
banTrappingAbilities.tip: Prevent trapping abilities like Mean Look

weighDuplicateAbilitiesTogether.label: Weigh Duplicate Abilities Together
weighDuplicateAbilitiesTogether.tip: Treat duplicate abilities as one option

abilitiesFollowEvolutions.label: Abilities Follow Evolutions
abilitiesFollowEvolutions.tip: Make evolution abilities follow base abilities

abilitiesFollowMegaEvolutions.label: Abilities Follow Mega Evolutions
abilitiesFollowMegaEvolutions.tip: Make mega evolution abilities follow base abilities

evosAllowAltFormes.label: Evolutions Allow Alternate Formes
evosAllowAltFormes.tip: Allow alternate formes in evolution chains

evosForceChange.label: Evolutions Force Change
evosForceChange.tip: Force all pokemon to have different evolved forms

evosMaxThreeStages.label: Evolutions Max Three Stages
evosMaxThreeStages.tip: Limit evolution chains to 3 stages maximum

evosForceGrowth.label: Evolutions Force Growth
evosForceGrowth.tip: Force evolution growth in randomized forms

evosNoConvergence.label: Evolutions No Convergence
evosNoConvergence.tip: Prevent multiple pokemon from evolving into the same form

evosSameTyping.label: Evolutions Same Typing
evosSameTyping.tip: Keep evolution types similar to base forms

evosSimilarStrength.label: Evolutions Similar Strength
evosSimilarStrength.tip: Keep evolution stats similar to base stats

standardizeEXPCurves.label: Standardize EXP Curves
standardizeEXPCurves.tip: Use a single EXP curve for selected pokemon

selectedEXPCurve.label: Selected EXP Curve
selectedEXPCurve.tip: Choose which EXP curve to standardize to

pokemonPalettesFollowTypes.label: Follow Types
pokemonPalettesFollowTypes.tip: When selected, Pokémon colors will depend on type. For example, a Fire-type Bulbasaur might be red, and a Grass-type Groudon might be green.

pokemonPalettesFollowEvolutions.label: Follow Evolutions
pokemonPalettesFollowEvolutions.tip: Each Pokémon species will have colors similar to those it evolves to/from. When evolutions are randomized, Pokémon get colors similar to their new evolutions/prevolutions.

pokemonPalettesShinyFromNormal.label: Shiny From Normal
pokemonPalettesShinyFromNormal.tip: The shiny colors of each Pokémon species become the colors it would normally have, if palettes were not randomized.

randomizeMovePowers.label: Randomize Move Power
randomizeMovePowers.tip: Randomize power of damaging moves between 20 and 150.

randomizeMoveAccuracies.label: Randomize Move Accuracy
randomizeMoveAccuracies.tip: Randomize move accuracy with restrictions to prevent broken moves.

randomizeMovePPs.label: Randomize Move PP
randomizeMovePPs.tip: Randomize the PP of each move in multiples of 5 (5-40).

randomizeMoveTypes.label: Randomize Move Types
randomizeMoveTypes.tip: Randomize the type of most moves.

randomizeMoveNames.label: Randomize Move Names
randomizeMoveNames.tip: Randomize move names based on their type (Gen 3+ only).

randomizeMoveCategory.label: Randomize Move Category
randomizeMoveCategory.tip: Randomize category of damaging moves between Physical and Special (Gen 4+).

updateMoves.label: Update Moves to Generation
updateMoves.tip: Update move stats to their values in the selected generation.

updateMovesToGeneration.label: Generation
updateMovesToGeneration.tip: Select the generation for move stat updates.

startWithGuaranteedMoves.label: Guaranteed Level 1 Moves
startWithGuaranteedMoves.tip: Every Pokémon gets a guaranteed amount of moves at level 1; set the count with the slider.

guaranteedMoveCount.label: Guaranteed Move Count
guaranteedMoveCount.tip: Number of moves guaranteed at level 1 (1-4; 4 = full moveset).

reorderDamagingMoves.label: Reorder Damaging Moves
reorderDamagingMoves.tip: Reorder moves so less powerful damaging moves are learned before powerful ones.

blockBrokenMovesetMoves.label: No Game-Breaking Moves
blockBrokenMovesetMoves.tip: Ban moves that can break early/late game from randomized movesets.

movesetsForceGoodDamaging.label: Force % of Good Damaging Moves
movesetsForceGoodDamaging.tip: Force a percentage of randomized movesets to include good damaging moves.

movesetsGoodDamagingPercent.label: Good Damaging %
movesetsGoodDamagingPercent.tip: Percentage of moves forced to be good damaging moves.

evolutionMovesForAll.label: Evolution Moves for All Pokémon
evolutionMovesForAll.tip: Every Pokémon learns a move upon evolution.

randomizeWildPokemon.label: Randomize Wild Pokémon
randomizeWildPokemon.tip: Whether to randomize wild Pokémon encounters.

useTimeBasedEncounters.label: Use Time-Based Encounters
useTimeBasedEncounters.tip: This affects games that have either seasons or morning/day/night encounter sets. If checked, each of these sets will be treated as a separate area. If unchecked, morning/day/night and all seasons will use the same encounter data.

blockWildLegendaries.label: Don't Use Legendaries
blockWildLegendaries.tip: Prevent legendary Pokémon from appearing as wild encounters.

randomizeWildPokemonHeldItems.label: Randomize Held Items
randomizeWildPokemonHeldItems.tip: Randomize the items held by Pokémon in the wild, including whether they can have one at all or not.

banBadRandomWildPokemonHeldItems.label: Ban Bad Items
banBadRandomWildPokemonHeldItems.tip: Remove 'bad' items that don't do much from the set of possible random items for wild Pokémon, such as berries and mail.

allowWildAltFormes.label: Allow Alternate Formes
allowWildAltFormes.tip: Allow alternate formes of Pokémon, such as the various formes of Rotom or Deoxys, to appear as wild Pokémon.

keepWildTypeThemes.label: Keep Set/Zone Themes
keepWildTypeThemes.tip: All encounter sets that originally had a type theme will keep that type theme.

splitWildZoneByEncounterTypes.label: Split by Encounter Types
splitWildZoneByEncounterTypes.tip: Split the game, map, or location by encounter types, such as walking, Surfing, fishing, and Rock Smash.

keepWildEvolutionFamilies.label: Keep Relations
keepWildEvolutionFamilies.tip: If multiple Pokémon related by evolution appear in the same zone, their replacements will also be related in the same way.

useMinimumCatchRate.label: Set Minimum Catch Rate
useMinimumCatchRate.tip: If selected, every Pokémon in the game with a catch rate below a certain level will have its catch rate increased.

minimumCatchRateLevel.label: Catch Rate Level
minimumCatchRateLevel.tip: Select the minimum catch rate level: Level 1 (Normal ~10-18%), Level 2 (Buffed ~17-26%), Level 3 (Super ~27-37%), Level 4 (Ultra ~34-44%), or Level 5 (Guaranteed).

wildLevelsModified.label: Percentage Level Modifier
wildLevelsModified.tip: Apply a percentage-based level modifier for every wild Pokémon in the game.

wildLevelModifier.label: Level Modifier %
wildLevelModifier.tip: Adjust wild Pokémon levels by this percentage (e.g., -50% to +50%).

catchEmAllEncounters.label: Catch 'Em All Mode
catchEmAllEncounters.tip: Every random Pokémon chosen to replace an encounter will be one that hasn't been chosen before. Once every Pokémon has been chosen once, any Pokémon may be chosen.

similarStrengthEncounters.label: Similar Strength
similarStrengthEncounters.tip: The random Pokémon that replaces each Pokémon will be of similar power to the original.

balanceShakingGrass.label: Balance Low Level Encounters
balanceShakingGrass.tip: Set an upper limit for the base stat total of wild Pokémon based on their level when using the Similar Strength setting.

blockBrokenTMMoves.label: No Game-Breaking Moves
blockBrokenTMMoves.tip: Checking this checkbox will stop moves that can break early/late games being available in randomized TMs. In first generation games, Dragon Rage, SonicBoom, Spore, and every OHKO move are banned. In second generation onwards, only SonicBoom and Dragon Rage are banned (because OHKO moves and sleep are significantly less broken).

keepFieldMoveTMs.label: Keep Field Move TMs
keepFieldMoveTMs.tip: If you select this, TMs that contain field-use moves will be left alone. This includes things like Dig & Teleport, but not healing moves (Softboiled).

tmsForceGoodDamaging.label: Force % of Good Damaging Moves
tmsForceGoodDamaging.tip: Selecting this option will allow you to use the slider below to select a proportion of the randomized TMs to be forced to be good damaging moves. Note that other TMs can still be selected as good damaging moves randomly, this is simply an additional chance.

tmsGoodDamagingPercent.label: Good Damaging Moves %
tmsGoodDamagingPercent.tip: The percentage of randomized TMs that will be forced to be good damaging moves.

tmsFollowEvolutions.label: Follow Evolutions
tmsFollowEvolutions.tip: When this is selected and TM compatibility is randomized, evolutions of a Pokemon will inherit that Pokemon's TM compatibilities. Additionally, when a Pokemon evolves, each TM will have: Random (prefer same type): A 90% chance of becoming learnable if the Pokemon just gained its type through evolution, a 10% chance otherwise. Random (completely): A 25% chance of becoming learnable regardless of type.

tmLevelUpMoveSanity.label: TM/Level-up Move Sanity
tmLevelUpMoveSanity.tip: If you select this option, then Pokemon will be guaranteed to learn TMs of moves that they learn by levelup. Otherwise, move compatibility will be left alone or decided randomly, depending on your other choices.

fullHMCompat.label: Full HM Compatibility
fullHMCompat.tip: If you select this option, then every Pokemon will learn every HM, regardless of any other options you check.

blockBrokenTutorMoves.label: No Game-Breaking Moves
blockBrokenTutorMoves.tip: Checking this checkbox will stop moves that can break early/late games being available in randomized move tutors. In first generation games, Dragon Rage, SonicBoom, Spore, and every OHKO move are banned. In second generation onwards, only SonicBoom and Dragon Rage are banned (because OHKO moves and sleep are significantly less broken).

keepFieldMoveTutors.label: Keep Field Move Tutors
keepFieldMoveTutors.tip: If you select this, move tutors that contain field-use moves will be left alone. This includes things like Headbutt, but not healing moves (Softboiled).

tutorsForceGoodDamaging.label: Force % of Good Damaging Moves
tutorsForceGoodDamaging.tip: Selecting this option will allow you to use the slider below to select a proportion of the randomized tutors to be forced to be good damaging moves. Note that other tutors can still be selected as good damaging moves randomly, this is simply an additional chance.

tutorsGoodDamagingPercent.label: Good Damaging Moves %
tutorsGoodDamagingPercent.tip: The percentage of randomized move tutors that will be forced to be good damaging moves.

tutorFollowEvolutions.label: Follow Evolutions
tutorFollowEvolutions.tip: When this is selected and move tutor compatibility is randomized, evolutions of a Pokemon will inherit that Pokemon's move tutor compatibilities. Additionally, when a Pokemon evolves, each move will have: Random (prefer same type): A 90% chance of becoming learnable if the Pokemon just gained its type through evolution, a 10% chance otherwise. Random (completely): A 25% chance of becoming learnable regardless of type.

tutorLevelUpMoveSanity.label: Tutor/Level-up Move Sanity
tutorLevelUpMoveSanity.tip: If you select this option, then Pokemon will be guaranteed to learn move tutors of moves that they learn by levelup. Otherwise, move compatibility will be left alone or decided randomly, depending on your other choices.

bstBuffNerfMaxPercentage.label: Random Buff/Nerf (%)
bstBuffNerfMaxPercentage.tip: Maximum BST change in percent when using Random Buff/Nerf (e.g. 20 = 80–120% of the original BST).

ensureTwoAbilities.label: Ensure Two Abilities
ensureTwoAbilities.tip: When abilities are randomized, ensure each Pokémon has two abilities.

estimateLevelForEvolutionImprovements.label: Use Estimated Evolution Levels
estimateLevelForEvolutionImprovements.tip: Evolutions changed by 'Change Impossible Evolutions' or 'Make Evolutions Easier' use levels estimated from the game's other evolutions instead of preset levels.

makeEvolutionsEasierLvl.label: Evolve By Level
makeEvolutionsEasierLvl.tip: The level by which every Pokémon should reach its final stage when 'Make Evolutions Easier' is on. At the maximum, evolution levels are unchanged (other improvements still apply).

inverseTypesRandomImmunities.label: Add Random Immunities
inverseTypesRandomImmunities.tip: A few weaknesses become immunities instead. The number of immunities added matches the base game.

updateTypeEffectiveness.label: Update Type Effectiveness
updateTypeEffectiveness.tip: Update type weaknesses/resistances/immunities to their Gen 6+ values before any randomization. Does not add the Fairy type.

miscBWExpPatch.label: B/W Exp Patch
miscBWExpPatch.tip: Patches R/B/Y and G/S/C to use the Black/White XP gain system (English only).

miscNerfXAccuracy.label: Nerf X Accuracy
miscNerfXAccuracy.tip: Stops Gen 1 X Accuracy from working on sleep, trapping and one-hit-KO moves.

miscFixCritRate.label: "Fix" Crit Rate
miscFixCritRate.tip: Fixes Gen 1's critical-hit rate to 1/16 instead of being Speed-based; Focus Energy/Dire Hit and high-crit moves behave like later games.

miscFastestText.label: Fastest Text
miscFastestText.tip: All text boxes show with minimum delay regardless of the in-game text-speed setting.

miscRunningShoesIndoors.label: Running Shoes Indoors
miscRunningShoesIndoors.tip: Lets you use the Running Shoes in any location, like later games.

miscRandomizePCPotion.label: Randomize PC Potion
miscRandomizePCPotion.tip: Randomizes the starting item-PC Potion to another useful item.

miscAllowPikachuEvolution.label: Allow Pikachu Evolution
miscAllowPikachuEvolution.tip: Lets Pikachu evolve into Raichu with a Thunder Stone (Yellow).

miscGiveNationalDexAt.label: Give National Dex at Start
miscGiveNationalDexAt.tip: Gives the National Dex at the start alongside the regional Pokédex.

miscForceChallengeMode.label: Force Challenge Mode
miscForceChallengeMode.tip: Forcibly enables Challenge Mode, bypassing the Key System (BW2). Easy/Normal become inaccessible.

miscLowerCasePokemonNames.label: Lower Case Pokémon Names
miscLowerCasePokemonNames.tip: Renders Pokémon names in Camel Case (e.g. VENUSAUR becomes Venusaur).

miscRandomizeCatchingTutorial.label: Randomize Catching Tutorial
miscRandomizeCatchingTutorial.tip: Randomizes the Pokémon shown in the game's catching tutorial.

miscBanLuckyEgg.label: Ban Lucky Egg
miscBanLuckyEgg.tip: Bans Lucky Egg from appearing as any randomized item.

miscNoFreeLuckyEgg.label: No Free Lucky Egg
miscNoFreeLuckyEgg.tip: Stops the professor from giving a free Lucky Egg (BW/BW2).

miscBanBigMoneyManiac.label: Ban Big Money Maniac Items
miscBanBigMoneyManiac.tip: Bans maniac items worth more than $10,000 from randomized item pools.

miscSOSBattles.label: All Wild Pokémon Can Call Allies
miscSOSBattles.tip: Lets every wild Pokémon call for help (SOS battles), not just those that could originally.

miscBalanceStaticLevels.label: Balance Static Pokémon Levels
miscBalanceStaticLevels.tip: Rebalances static Pokémon levels (fossils in FRLG/BW1).

miscRetainAltFormes.label: Don't Revert Temporary Alt Formes
miscRetainAltFormes.tip: Party Pokémon keep their alternate forme after a reset/battle instead of reverting.

miscRunWithoutRunningShoes.label: Run Without Running Shoes
miscRunWithoutRunningShoes.tip: Lets you run before acquiring the Running Shoes.

miscFasterHPAndEXPBars.label: Faster HP and EXP Bars
miscFasterHPAndEXPBars.tip: Doubles the scroll speed of the in-battle HP and EXP bars.

miscFastDistortionWorld.label: Fast Distortion World
miscFastDistortionWorld.tip: Skips most of the Distortion World, warping you to the Cyrus fight (Platinum).

miscUpdateRotomFormeTyping.label: Update Rotom Appliance Typings
miscUpdateRotomFormeTyping.tip: Updates Rotom's appliance formes to their Gen 5+ typings (e.g. Wash Rotom becomes Electric/Water).

miscDisableLowHPMusic.label: Disable Low HP Music
miscDisableLowHPMusic.tip: Disables the low-HP warning music so the current track keeps playing.

customStarter.tip: Species ID of the custom starter. The web editor has no species-name list yet, so enter the FVX species index (it round-trips correctly).

startersSingleType.label: Single Type
startersSingleType.tip: All randomly-chosen starters will be of this type; 'Random' picks one type for all of them.

startersNoDualTypes.label: No Dual Types
startersNoDualTypes.tip: Chosen starters will not be dual-typed (they may still evolve into dual-types).

allowStarterAltFormes.label: Allow Alternate Formes
allowStarterAltFormes.tip: Allow alternate formes (e.g. Rotom, Deoxys) to appear as starters.

startersNoLegendaries.label: Don't Use Legendaries
startersNoLegendaries.tip: Legendary Pokémon will not be chosen as starters.

startersBSTMinimum.label: Minimum BST
startersBSTMinimum.tip: No Pokémon below this base stat total may be a starter.

startersBSTMaximum.label: Maximum BST
startersBSTMaximum.tip: No Pokémon above this base stat total may be a starter.

randomizeStartersHeldItems.label: Randomize Starter Held Items
randomizeStartersHeldItems.tip: Randomize the items held by the starters where possible.

banBadRandomStarterHeldItems.label: Ban Bad Items
banBadRandomStarterHeldItems.tip: Remove low-value items (berries, mail) from the random starter held-item pool.

swapStaticMegaEvos.label: Swap Mega Evolvables
swapStaticMegaEvos.tip: Swap static Pokémon capable of Mega Evolution with another such Pokémon.

limit600.label: Randomize 600+ BST
limit600.tip: Enforce pure random on all static Pokémon with 600+ BST.

allowStaticAltFormes.label: Allow Alternate Formes
allowStaticAltFormes.tip: Allow alternate formes to appear as static Pokémon.

limitMainGameLegendaries.label: Limit Main-Game Legendaries
limitMainGameLegendaries.tip: Prevent main-game legendaries from being replaced by Pokémon with higher base stat totals.

correctStaticMusic.label: Fix Music
correctStaticMusic.tip: Play the correct special music for randomized static encounters.

staticLevelModified.label: Percentage Level Modifier
staticLevelModified.tip: Enable a percentage-based level modifier for every static Pokémon.

staticLevelModifier.label: Static Level Modifier
staticLevelModifier.tip: Percentage change applied to static Pokémon levels.

randomizeInGameTradesNicknames.label: Randomize Nicknames
randomizeInGameTradesNicknames.tip: Randomize the nicknames of received traded Pokémon.

randomizeInGameTradesOTs.label: Randomize OTs
randomizeInGameTradesOTs.tip: Randomize the Original Trainer (ID & name) of received traded Pokémon.

randomizeInGameTradesIVs.label: Randomize IVs
randomizeInGameTradesIVs.tip: Randomize the IVs of received traded Pokémon.

randomizeInGameTradesItems.label: Randomize Items
randomizeInGameTradesItems.tip: Give each received traded Pokémon a random held item.

battleStyleStyle.label: Battle Style
battleStyleStyle.tip: When 'Single Style' is chosen, set all trainer battles to this style.

rivalCarriesStarterThroughout.label: Rival Carries Starter Through Game
rivalCarriesStarterThroughout.tip: The rival keeps their starter (evolved as appropriate) in every battle.

trainersUsePokemonOfSimilarStrength.label: Use Pokémon of Similar Strength
trainersUsePokemonOfSimilarStrength.tip: Replacement Pokémon are of similar power to the original.

trainersAvoidDuplicates.label: Avoid Duplicates
trainersAvoidDuplicates.tip: A trainer's randomized Pokémon are different from each other where possible.

trainersMatchTypingDistribution.label: Weight Types by # of Pokémon
trainersMatchTypingDistribution.tip: Match the number of trainers of each type to the number of Pokémon of that type.

trainersUseLocalPokemon.label: Use Local Pokémon
trainersUseLocalPokemon.tip: Trainers use only Pokémon found in the wild and their evolutionary relatives.

trainersBlockLegendaries.label: Don't Use Legendaries
trainersBlockLegendaries.tip: Legendary Pokémon will not be given to trainers.

trainersBlockEarlyWonderGuard.label: No Early Wonder Guard
trainersBlockEarlyWonderGuard.tip: No trainer under level 20 is given a Wonder Guard Pokémon.

allowTrainerAlternateFormes.label: Allow Alternate Formes
allowTrainerAlternateFormes.tip: Allow trainers to have alternate formes of Pokémon.

swapTrainerMegaEvos.label: Swap Mega Evolvables
swapTrainerMegaEvos.tip: Swap trainer Pokémon holding a Mega Stone with another Mega-capable Pokémon.

shinyChance.label: Random Shiny Trainer Pokémon
shinyChance.tip: Gives a 1/256 chance of trainer Pokémon being shiny.

trainersEvolveTheirPokemon.label: Trainers Evolve Their Pokémon
trainersEvolveTheirPokemon.tip: Guarantee that trainer Pokémon are evolved as far as possible for their level.

trainersEvolutionLevelModifier.label: Evolution Level Modifier
trainersEvolutionLevelModifier.tip: Percentage modifier applied to the levels at which trainer Pokémon evolve.

trainersLevelModified.label: Percentage Level Modifier
trainersLevelModified.tip: Enable a percentage-based level modifier for every enemy trainer Pokémon.

trainersLevelModifier.label: Trainer Level Modifier
trainersLevelModifier.tip: Percentage change applied to trainer Pokémon levels.

eliteFourUniquePokemonNumber.label: Pokémon League Has Unique Pokémon
eliteFourUniquePokemonNumber.tip: Elite Four/Champion trainers get this many unique Pokémon that appear on no other trainer.

additionalBossTrainerPokemon.label: Add Pokémon to Boss Trainers
additionalBossTrainerPokemon.tip: Add this many Pokémon to Boss trainers (max 6 total).

additionalImportantTrainerPokemon.label: Add Pokémon to Important Trainers
additionalImportantTrainerPokemon.tip: Add this many Pokémon to Important trainers (max 6 total).

additionalRegularTrainerPokemon.label: Add Pokémon to Regular Trainers
additionalRegularTrainerPokemon.tip: Add this many Pokémon to regular trainers (max 6 total).

randomizeHeldItemsForBossTrainerPokemon.label: Held Items — Boss Trainers
randomizeHeldItemsForBossTrainerPokemon.tip: Add or replace held items for Boss trainers' Pokémon.

randomizeHeldItemsForImportantTrainerPok.label: Held Items — Important Trainers
randomizeHeldItemsForImportantTrainerPok.tip: Add or replace held items for Important trainers' Pokémon.

randomizeHeldItemsForRegularTrainerPokem.label: Held Items — Regular Trainers
randomizeHeldItemsForRegularTrainerPokem.tip: Add or replace held items for regular trainers' Pokémon.

consumableItemsOnlyForTrainerPokemon.label: Consumable Only
consumableItemsOnlyForTrainerPokemon.tip: Trainer held items are chosen from single-use items (mostly berries).

sensibleItemsOnlyForTrainerPokemon.label: Sensible Items
sensibleItemsOnlyForTrainerPokemon.tip: Trainer held items are chosen from items that make sense for that Pokémon.

highestLevelOnlyGetsItemsForTrainerPokem.label: Highest Level Only
highestLevelOnlyGetsItemsForTrainerPokem.tip: Only a trainer's highest-level Pokémon receives a held item.

diverseTypesForBossTrainers.label: Type Diversity — Boss Trainers
diverseTypesForBossTrainers.tip: Boss trainers avoid using multiple Pokémon of the same type.

diverseTypesForImportantTrainers.label: Type Diversity — Important Trainers
diverseTypesForImportantTrainers.tip: Important trainers avoid using multiple Pokémon of the same type.

diverseTypesForRegularTrainers.label: Type Diversity — Regular Trainers
diverseTypesForRegularTrainers.tip: Regular trainers avoid using multiple Pokémon of the same type.

betterBossTrainerMovesets.label: Better Movesets — Boss Trainers
betterBossTrainerMovesets.tip: Give Boss trainers better movesets (TM/tutor/egg moves and synergy).

betterImportantTrainerMovesets.label: Better Movesets — Important Trainers
betterImportantTrainerMovesets.tip: Give Important trainers better movesets (TM/tutor/egg moves and synergy).

betterRegularTrainerMovesets.label: Better Movesets — Regular Trainers
betterRegularTrainerMovesets.tip: Give regular trainers better movesets (TM/tutor/egg moves and synergy).

randomizeTotemHeldItems.label: Randomize Held Items
randomizeTotemHeldItems.tip: Replace Totem Pokémon's held items with consumable items.

allowTotemAltFormes.label: Allow Alternate Formes
allowTotemAltFormes.tip: Allow alternate formes to appear as Totem/Ally Pokémon.

totemLevelsModified.label: Percentage Level Modifier
totemLevelsModified.tip: Enable a percentage-based level modifier for Totem/Ally Pokémon.

totemLevelModifier.label: Totem Level Modifier
totemLevelModifier.tip: Percentage change applied to Totem/Ally Pokémon levels.

banBadRandomFieldItems.label: Ban Bad Items
banBadRandomFieldItems.tip: Remove "bad" items that don't do much from the set of possible random items for field items, such as berries and mail.

banBadRandomShopItems.label: Ban Bad Items
banBadRandomShopItems.tip: Remove "bad" items that don't do much from the set of possible random items for shop items, such as berries and mail.

banRegularShopItems.label: Ban Regular Shop Items
banRegularShopItems.tip: Remove regular shop items from the possible random items for shop items.

guaranteeEvolutionItems.label: Guarantee Evolution Items
guaranteeEvolutionItems.tip: Ensure all evolution items appear in shops.

guaranteeXItems.label: Guarantee X Items
guaranteeXItems.tip: Ensure all X items (including Guard Spec. and Dire Hit) appear in shops.

banOPShopItems.label: Ban Overpowered Shop Items
banOPShopItems.tip: Remove overpowered shop items from the pool, such as the Lucky Egg and items that sell for high prices to maniacs.

balanceShopPrices.label: Balance Shop Item Prices
balanceShopPrices.tip: Change prices for many items to make them more balanced. Note: prices for some items are seriously imbalanced without this setting.

addCheapRareCandiesToShops.label: Add Cheap Rare Candies
addCheapRareCandiesToShops.tip: Add cheap Rare Candies to all shops. (With a few exceptions, such as the HGSS Pokéathlon shops.)

banBadRandomPickupItems.label: Ban Bad Items
banBadRandomPickupItems.tip: Remove "bad" items that don't do much from the set of possible random items for the Pickup item table, such as berries and mail.

events.romsDesc: Manage ROM library for randomizer configs
events.romsUploadInvalid: ROM name and file are required
events.romsDeleteConfirmMsg: Delete “{name}”? This action cannot be undone.
events.romsDeleteReferencedWarning: Cannot delete “{name}” — it is referenced by {count} config(s). Remove references before deleting.
events.romsEmpty: No ROMs in library. Upload one to get started.

blurb.general: Global constraints applied across every category.
blurb.traits: Base stats, types, abilities and evolutions of every species.
blurb.starters: Starter trio, type restrictions, static & gift Pokémon, in-game trades.
blurb.moves: Move stats and the movesets Pokémon learn by level-up.
blurb.foes: Trainer teams, held items, levels, bosses and battle style.
blurb.wild: Overworld encounters, catch rate, levels and held items.
blurb.tmhm: TM moves, HM compatibility and Move Tutor moves.
blurb.items: Field items, shop stock and pickup rewards.
blurb.graphics: Palettes, sprites, names and cries — no gameplay impact.
blurb.misc: Quality-of-life patches that don't fit elsewhere.

warnings.bstMinMax: Minimum BST is above the maximum — no starter can qualify.
warnings.raceMode: Race mode needs either trainer or wild Pokémon randomization enabled.
warnings.metronome: Metronome-only movesets ignore TM & tutor move quality settings.
warnings.typeChart: A changed type chart affects the entire game's balance.
warnings.fullHmRedundant: Full HM compatibility is redundant with full TM/HM compatibility.
warnings.wonderGuard: Wonder Guard on random trainers can spike difficulty hard.

validation.titleMin: Title must be at least 3 characters
validation.descMin: Description must be at least 10 characters
validation.nameMin: Name must be at least 3 characters
validation.progressMin: Max progress must be at least 1
